about: Is 5G draining your battery? Factory #34, backlog row 40, slug 5gbattery. One hard idea: 5G can cost more battery than LTE, but only when it is barely used; in a 2021 University of Minnesota/Michigan power-meter study (Narayanan et al., SIGCOMM 2021; Galaxy S20 Ultra on Verizon) 5G was up to 79% less energy-efficient than 4G at low throughput and up to 5x more efficient at high throughput, which is why iPhone's 5G Auto (Smart Data mode) and Pixel's Adaptive connectivity drop to LTE when 5G won't help. Check: is yours on 5G Auto? Sources read 2026-11-17, see BRIEF.md.

lines.say: Yes, five G can drain your battery.
